input.prompt:
Create ONE complete finished 3200x1440 game screen in the EXACT approved visual system of Image1. Image1 is our approved 风暴怕死队-style battle master. The user approved this direction: preserve its hanging-page tabs, enlarged hand-drawn resource icons, letterforms, palette, timber/brass frames, slot surfaces, item art, contour weight and spacing. Supporting official screenshots establish the same UI family; do not copy their game text or mechanics.

Keep the shared header pixel positions and scale. Exactly three tabs 装备栏位 / 英雄属性 / 装备图鉴; change only the selected tab as this page requires. Top right remains 生命180/180 full, 体力100/100 full, 腐化0/100 EMPTY, 金币4. Preserve the master's LARGE icons and numbers; never shrink them. All body text must be clear at phone scale: preferably at least56px, important numbers64px. Keep Chinese typography consistent with Image1.

Unless the page explicitly replaces the left+central area with a wide sheet, preserve BOTH side panels from Image1: 战斗装备 and 背包, matching top, bottom, width, title baseline and all four card rows. Both use ONE COLUMN of full-width horizontal cards, never split cells. Default left cards: green vial8/1, pale mushroom4 only, silver dagger30/2 with one purple enchantment mark and EMPTY0/100; fourth locked. Default right: three empty full-width cards and bottom locked. Page-specific ownership changes below override only those stated rows. Names/descriptions do not appear permanently on the equipped side cards.

Only the central page content, contextual title and authorized states/actions change. Use the approved hand-inked, warm brown/ochre UI with simple colored item art; no new art style, generic dark CSS boxes, photoreal metallic bevels, copied source-game branding, keyboard hints or developer placeholders. Selected controls and buttons should share the official game's warm amber/green-corner visual language and readable cream lettering. One primary task/action; align all bottom actions, with quieter secondary action at the left and primary at right. Remove battle aiming instructions on non-battle pages. Do not invent game features, fees, resources or extra controls beyond the page spec. Render the ENTIRE final screenshot with all art, labels and numbers in the image model.


PAGE 07 — 营地 · 保险箱存取 / CAMP SAFE STORAGE

Generate one COMPLETE safe-storage screen using the shared style and approved 风暴怕死队 UI master. Preserve the hanging paper PAGE TABS and large status icons, their positions, all top resource values, the left and right panel bounds, titles and card baselines. “装备栏位” remains the selected global tab. The central page title is “保险箱”; show the concise protection text “死亡后保留”.

EXACT OWNERSHIP STATE — ONE MUSHROOM IN THE SAFE:
The sole current 灵魂香菇 has ALREADY BEEN DEPOSITED in the safe. Show this state consistently across the entire screen:
LEFT “战斗装备”: row 1 contains 凝血毒剂 with damage 8 and recycle 1; row 2 is EMPTY and has no mushroom and no value-4 badge; row 3 contains 淬毒利刃 with damage 30, recycle 2, one purple enchantment marker and EMPTY charge 0/100; row 4 is the existing locked card. Do not slide the dagger upward into the emptied middle row.
RIGHT “背包”: THREE EMPTY FULL-WIDTH horizontal cards in ONE column, plus the existing bottom locked card. No carried mushroom or other object.
CENTRAL SAFE: exactly ONE stored-item card containing the selected 灵魂香菇, using the same mushroom identity and full-width card language as the master. Give this stored card the recycle/value badge 4 and no damage badge. The selected item is held by the safe, not the equipment panel and not the backpack. Never depict another owned mushroom copy, a drag ghost or a second reward card elsewhere. Use text-only selected details beside or below this one card to keep the single-copy state unambiguous.

The central safe is visibly distinct from the carried backpack through its “保险箱” heading, protection text and position within the camp chest interface. It may show a restrained camp-chest backdrop within the existing central content area. Do not turn the safe into another two-column backpack or invent its total capacity, expansion state, extra locks or additional stored possessions.

SELECTED CURRENT-INSTANCE TEXT:
“灵魂香菇”
“每搜寻过一次物品，增加4价值。最多不超过16。”
Use the CURRENT INSTANCE values 4 and 16. Do not substitute the bronze catalogue's 2 and 8, and do not label this item with an unsupported quality or level.

One prominent main action: “取出到背包”.
One secondary action: “返回营地”.
These controls share a tidy action baseline and the approved master button family. The depicted state is BEFORE withdrawal: the card is still in the safe and the backpack is empty. No sale, upgrade, crafting, interest, deposit charge, withdrawal fee or invented currency cost. Keep all corresponding left/right card edges aligned and preserve the full-width single-column structure. Render the complete screen with all text and controls, without notes about the concept, implementation or generation process inside the game UI.
